test.description: The router hands search-hints the planned hints item pli_007 for Patrick Flynn (LZNY-BRF), with no userPresent, which means the researcher is there. Three hints are pending. Triage recommends a verdict for each and moves pli_007 to in_progress, where it waits for the researcher's verdicts. It logs nothing: a positive entry would read as evidence waiting for extraction, and an entry naming the item would read as the item executed (issue #3153).
